AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE INVESTMENT POLICY ADVISORY COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Investment Policy Advisory Committee is a new committee, effective July 1, 2017. With the City Treasurer, the Committee shall be responsible for recommending investment brokers, proposing changes to investment policy and practices, presenting investment reports, and evaluating and recommending banking-related matters. Meetings are to review, discuss and develop recommendation on matters such as investment and banking vendors, policy, transactions, returns and performance, brokers, and strategy.
The Investment Policy Advisory Committee, at the direction of the Chairman with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the Secretary to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and, if any, documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the Secretary at 310-378-0383, at least 24 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Investment Policy Advisory Committee welcomes and encourages public participation at the Committee meetings. This meeting will be held via videoconference only in order to reduce the risk of spreading COVID-19 and pursuant to AB 361 and the County of Los Angeles Public Health Officer's recommended measures to promote social distancing. All votes taken during this teleconference meeting will be by roll call vote, and the vote will be publicly reported.
HOW TO VIEW THE MEETING: No physical location from which members of the public may observe the meeting and offer public comment will be provided. The meeting will not be livestreamed; however, the meeting will be recorded and made available on the City's website. You may attend the meeting through a computer or telephone:
BY COMPUTER: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83840722263
Zoom Meeting ID: 838 4072 2263
BY TELEPHONE: 1 669 900 9128, Enter Code: 838 4072 2263#
HOW TO PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING: Please submit your correspondence in writing to pvefinance@pvestates.org. Comments received by NOON on Thursday, February 24, 2022 will be included with the posted agenda. Additional comments received by NOON on Tuesday, March 1, 2022 will be forwarded to the Members and posted online as late correspondence. All correspondence submitted electronically via email will be provided to the legislative body, but will not be read aloud at the meeting.
HOW TO PARTICIPATE DURING THE MEETING: Members of the public are encouraged to participate under COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC or on any item of interest on the Agenda by simply utilizing the "Raise Hand" feature during the item under consideration. When called upon to speak please state your name for the record. Members of the public are not required to submit notification in advance.
Agenda reports and other disclosable public documents relating to each Agenda Item are available on the City's website under Investment Policy Advisory Meeting Agendas at www.pvestates.org.

Recommendation: That the Committee review and make recommendations to the City Treasurer regarding the following: (1) Status of transfer from LAIF to LA County Pool; (2) Update on investment of $1.5M of portfolio (roughly 5%) in 3-5 year TIPS (Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities) or STIPs (funds invested in TIPS); (4) Next steps in allocation of assets.
